value.rationale: An all-dimensional random-section complexity law for any bounded aspect-ratio empirical profile distinguishes typical exponential geometry from the shape-invariant exact arithmetic mean. The strict global cubical comparison and two distinct spectral shape signatures (second and reciprocal first moments) resolve natural shape optimization and extreme-section questions, rather than routine constant substitution. The known homogeneous rate and mean are not presented as new.
